prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a handsome young man in his early 20s, captured in an intimate candid editorial style, inspired by the reference image’s composition and warm cinematic atmosphere but featuring a completely original person.
He has thick, naturally wavy dark-black hair, slightly tousled and falling naturally across his forehead, deep expressive brown eyes, strong well-defined eyebrows, a straight sculpted nose, prominent cheekbones, a sharp masculine jawline, naturally defined lips, and subtle clean stubble. His expression is calm, confident, thoughtful, and effortlessly charming.
He is wearing a loose, premium white linen shirt, slightly unbuttoned at the collar, with natural fabric wrinkles and realistic texture. He is sitting casually beside a large vintage café/window doorway, turning his face slightly toward the warm sunlight.
Composition: vertical portrait, medium close-up to waist-up framing, subject positioned slightly off-center, looking toward the side rather than directly at the camera. Foreground contains soft out-of-focus green leaves, creating beautiful natural depth and framing the subject.
Lighting: gorgeous late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight streaming from the side, warm highlights across his face and hair, gentle natural shadows, subtle rim light, realistic skin texture, soft cinematic contrast.
Background: dark, elegant café interior visible through the doorway, heavily blurred, warm brown and black tones, subtle practical lights, shallow depth of field.
Photography: luxury fashion editorial photography, 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, extremely shallow depth of field, natural bokeh, realistic skin pores, detailed hair strands, authentic linen texture, subtle film grain, sophisticated color grading, photorealistic, cinematic, high dynamic range, premium magazine aesthetic, candid and effortless mood, 8K ultra-detailed realism.
Avoid: cartoon, anime, plastic skin, excessive retouching, distorted face, unnatural eyes, extra fingers, oversaturated colors, artificial-looking hair, exaggerated muscles, text, watermark.

promptZh: 超写实的电影感肖像，主体为 一位 20 出头的英俊年轻男子，采用亲密且自然的编辑风格拍摄，灵感源自参考图的构图与温暖的电影氛围，但呈现的是一个完全原创的人物。他拥有浓密、自然的深黑色波浪卷发，略显凌乱地自然垂落在额前；深邃且富有表现力的棕色眼睛，轮廓分明的浓眉，笔挺的鼻梁，突出的颧骨，线条硬朗的男性下颌线，轮廓自然的双唇，以及干净利落的胡茬。他的表情平静、自信、深沉且充满魅力。他身穿 一件宽松的高级白色亚麻衬衫，领口微敞，展现出自然的织物褶皱和逼真的质感。他随意地坐着，位置 在一家复古咖啡馆的窗边/门口旁，脸庞微微转向温暖的阳光。构图：竖构图肖像，中景至半身取景，主体略微偏离中心，视线看向侧方而非直视镜头。前景包含柔和且失焦的绿叶，营造出优美的自然景深并衬托主体。光影：华丽的午后黄金时刻阳光从侧面射入，面部和发丝带有温暖的高光，柔和的自然阴影，细腻的轮廓光，逼真的皮肤纹理，柔和的电影感对比度。背景：透过门口可见深邃优雅的咖啡馆内景，高度模糊，呈现温暖的棕色与黑色调，带有细微的实用灯光，浅景深效果。摄影：奢华时尚杂志摄影，85mm 人像镜头，f/1.8 大光圈，极浅景深，自然虚化，逼真的皮肤毛孔，细腻的发丝，真实的亚麻质感，细腻的胶片颗粒感，高级的色彩分级，照片级写实，电影感，高动态范围，高端杂志审美，自然随性的氛围，8K 超高清写实。避免：卡通、动漫、塑料感皮肤、过度修图、面部畸变、不自然的眼睛、多余的手指、色彩过饱和、人工感发丝、夸张的肌肉、文字、水印。
